raw: {"tool":"plan-draft","args":{"inbox_id":"gh-1168-2cba856d87cc","authored":{"scope":["Verify PR #1024 and the current scheduler and weekly intake mechanisms, then plan one shared local scheduler with the #1184 read-only report as its first job.","Plan daily held weekly preparation and a start-marathon entry point that consumes the accumulated auto-date predecessor root, without granting dispatch authority.","Keep existing launchd jobs and remote or hosted wake outside scope, and add no new tests."],"acceptance":["Each Mac has one launchd user agent running a named job list with per-job scheduling, checkout, held or dry-run setting, kill switch, and single-instance lock.","Each run records device, start and end times, and exit code under .tick/scheduler/, with the last successful run visible to doctor.","Missed runs are recorded as skipped, with no duplicate catch-up or automatic retry; waking from sleep is treated like a crash.","Installing the scheduler enables no jobs; each job requires explicit operator approval before being switched on.","Daily weekly-prepare runs against a fresh full clone with HELD and dispatch false, and Friday planning can use the accumulated ledger without rediscovery.","Any fire remains subject to explicit operator approval."],"open_questions":["Has PR #1024 landed, and what current interfaces and receipts does it provide?","How should skipped runs and interrupted runs be detected and recorded across sleep, logout, and login?","What existing verification covers the scheduler and its jobs without adding tests?"]}},"reason":"The oldest actionable request is the eligible plan request for issue #1168; the budget and flags permit processing it.","confidence":0.99}
